app.name: NirapodElaka
app.disclaimer: NirapodElaka is a community platform. It is not an official government service or emergency response organization. In an emergency, contact emergency services immediately.
app.demoNotice: This map shows demonstration data. Reports are not real.
app.unverifiedNotice: Community reports may be unverified. Use your own judgment.
